signal.bull: completed D1 close > causal EMA200 and 60D close-to-close return > 0
signal.bear: completed D1 close < causal EMA200 and 60D close-to-close return < 0

entry_execution: position for day t+1 is determined only after day t close and entered/rebalanced at next D1 open
rebalancing: hold existing side while regime unchanged; pay trading cost only when absolute exposure changes, including LONG<->SHORT switch as two one-way legs
stop_loss: none; this is a pure regime-following benchmark
take_profit: none; exit or reverse only when completed D1 regime changes
ema200: recursive EMA alpha=2/(200+1), adjust=False semantics, requiring 200 completed closes before first valid signal
funding: actual funding timestamps strictly inside each held open-to-open interval; LONG pays positive funding / receives negative; SHORT receives positive / pays negative
cost_accounting: half the stated round-trip cost per unit change in absolute signed exposure: flat->long/short one half, long/short->flat one half, long<->short full round-trip equivalent
promotion_note: historical pass means research/shadow eligible only; no demo/live order authority
